user.title: Connect to Silo
user.description: Use an API key created by a server admin with no scopes. An admin key is needed for now-playing state and pause/resume/stop.

data_description.api_key: Starts with sa_. Paste the key only, without 'Bearer'.

profile.title: Profile and TVs
profile.description: Pick the profile used to browse, shuffle and clear resume points, and the Android TV (ADB) players that run the Silo app.

abort.already_configured: This Silo server is already set up.
abort.wrong_server: That key belongs to a different Silo server.

data_description.wake_delay: How long to wait after waking a TV that was off before sending the play link.

tvs.title: TV addresses
tvs.description: The IP address each TV appears as in Silo's playback sessions. It's filled in from the Android TV integration; change it only if Silo sees the TV at a different address ({tvs}).

play.name: Play
play.description: Play a Silo movie or episode on a TV. A series or season id plays a random episode.

content_id.name: Content ID
content_id.description: Silo content id, like movie-tmdb-862, episode-tvdb-353546-2-8 or series-tvdb-353546.

from_start.name: From start
from_start.description: Clear the profile's resume point first so playback starts at the beginning. This also marks the item unwatched.

skip_if_playing.name: Skip if already playing
skip_if_playing.description: Do nothing if this title (or, for a series or season, any of its episodes) is already playing on the TV.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Override the profile used for shuffling and clearing the resume point.

shuffle.name: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Play a random episode of a Silo series or season on a TV.

scope_id.name: Series or season ID
scope_id.description: Silo series or season id, like series-tvdb-353546 or season-tvdb-353546-2.

from_start.name: From start
from_start.description: Start the picked episode from the beginning.

skip_if_playing.name: Skip if already playing
skip_if_playing.description: Do nothing if an episode of this series or season is already playing.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Override the profile used for the random pick.
